messages.content:
'Final'

獲取在洛杉磯法院提出的案件編號為「123456-ABC」的訴訟詳情，並獲得「最終」的判決結果。

function.name: get_lawsuit_details
function.description: Retrieve details of a lawsuit based on its case number and court location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

court_location.description: The location of the court where the lawsuit was filed.

with_verdict.description: Flag to include verdict details if available. Default is False

message.reasoning:
The user says "'Final'" and then Chinese: "獲取在洛杉磯法院提出的案件編號為「123456-ABC」的訴訟詳情，並獲得「最終」的判決結果。"

They want to retrieve lawsuit details for case number "123456-ABC" filed in Los Angeles court, and get the "final" verdict result.

We have a tool get_lawsuit_details. We need to call it with case_number "123456-ABC", court_location "Los Angeles" (or "Los Angeles Court"?). The user says "洛杉磯法院" which is Los Angeles Court. So we can use "Los Angeles" or "Los Angeles Court". The function expects a string for court_location. We'll pass "Los Angeles".

Also they want "最終" verdict result. The function has with_verdict optional boolean. If we set with_verdict true, we get verdict details. But do we need to specify "final" verdict? The function doesn't have a parameter for final verdict. It just includes verdict details if available. So we can set with_verdict true.

Thus we call the function get_lawsuit_details with case_number "123456-ABC", court_location "Los Angeles", with_verdict true.

We should not mention the tool usage to the user. We just call the tool.
